quote: Metrics. We define the following evaluation metrics for our content analysis tasks. For various classification tasks, we employ standard multiclass classification accuracy and define the multilabel classification accuracy as ACC = 1 - Hamming Loss. Furthermore, we use the agreement rate-defined as the proportion of text entries where all agents concur-to assess the level of consensus during discussions.
